title: The $541 Million That Never Arrived — Allen Stanford's Last Bluff

lines.say: Late two thousand eight. Investors are pulling money out of Allen Stanford's bank.
lines.show: Late 2008. Investors are pulling money out of Allen Stanford's bank.

lines.say: Its December report tells them it just received a capital infusion of five hundred forty-one million dollars.
lines.show: Its December report tells them it just received a capital infusion of $541 million.

lines.say: The S.E.C. said it was real estate the bank already owned, acquired for about eighty-eight and a half million.
lines.show: The SEC said it was real estate the bank already owned, acquired for about $88.5 million.

lines.say: Prosecutors said accountants marked up land bought for sixty-three and a half million dollars by five thousand percent, to three point one billion, on paper.
lines.show: Prosecutors said accountants marked up land bought for $63.5 million by 5,000 percent, to $3.1 billion, on paper.

lines.say: At his estate in Saint Croix, an employee testified, records were burned in barrels.
lines.show: At his estate in St. Croix, an employee testified, records were burned in barrels.

lines.say: In February two thousand nine, a receiver took over. Stanford got one hundred ten years.
lines.show: In February 2009, a receiver took over. Stanford got 110 years.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.

label: SWORN
